channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Linux 7.3 Released
item.description: Linus Torvalds has released the 7.3 kernel, as expected. It's Sunday afternoon, and this wee [...] (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Timestral: Mistral release time-series foundation models
item.description: State-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting in four sizes (5M–209M params), CPU-efficient, zero-shot ready. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 Expands Beyond Text to Support Code, Images, Video, and Audio
item.description: Based on Gemma 4 and released under the Apache 2.0 license, Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 is a compact, open-weight, multimodal embedding model designed to make semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) more efficient while… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: .NET 11 Release Candidate 2: Go-Live License and Updates Across Libraries, F#, MAUI, and WinForms
item.description: Microsoft has released .NET 11 Release Candidate 2 under a go-live license, supported in Visual Studio 2026 Insiders. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: NestJS 12: ESM Packages, Standard Schema Validation and Native Observability
item.description: NestJS version 12 has been released, transitioning core packages to ESM and adding Standard Schema validation. It updates the CLI and introduces an observability SDK. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Time Sync Service adds support for microsecond-accurate time on 135 additional EC2 instance types in all commercial regions
item.description: Amazon Time Sync Service introduces support for microsecond-accurate time on 135 additional EC2 instance types—spanning 12 instance families—in all commercial regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transform for full-stack Windows modernization now supports Aurora PostgreSQL cross-region deployment in 7 more Regions
item.description: Today, AWS Transform for full-stack Windows modernization adds support for cross-region deployment of converted Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL databases and is available in seven additional AWS Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon MSK Connect and AWS Glue Schema Registry are now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region
item.description: Starting today, Amazon MSK Connect and the AWS Glue Schema Registry are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudFront announces dual-stack support for VPC origins
item.description: Amazon CloudFront now supports end-to-end IPv6 delivery to origins inside your Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC), with the new dual-stack VPC origins. (1 source: aws)

item.title: PostgreSQL 19 RC1 is now available in Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment
item.description: Starting today, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 19 Release Candidate 1 (RC1) is available in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment , allowing you to evaluate the pre-release of PostgreSQL 19 on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Redshift long-term system table retention with Amazon S3 Tables is now available in additional AWS Regions
item.description: Amazon Redshift long-term retention for system table data through native integration with Amazon S3 Tables is now available in additional AWS Regions. (1 source: aws)
